snippet.title: Colony on the Run – Official Trailer | Multiply, Evolve, and Survive the Human Body!
snippet.description:
Multiply. Evolve. Survive the human body!

Colony on the Run is a survival game where you control a growing colony of bacteria and journey through the human body.

Escape from white blood cells, survive waves of antibiotics, and acquire new abilities as you search for a place where your colony can finally live in peace.

The throat, bronchi, lungs, bloodstream, and brain—
for bacteria, the human body is an incredibly harsh world.

But life keeps multiplying. And evolving.

A survival game from the bacteria's point of view, created by a practicing physician.

Colony on the Run
Coming to Steam in late 2026.
